# puercgp scheduling reference

`online_offset_evaluator.hxx` is an unchanged copy of `/home/zyl/Projects/ocgp/puercgp/include/puercgp/scheduling/online_offset_evaluator.hxx` taken on 2026-09-21. It provides the frozen landmark phase index and offset evaluator, including deterministic seed and tie rules. The source project has no license file in its `puercgp/` subtree. This copy is included only by GraphWeft's scheduler implementation and does not link the old project.
